description: Create a text frame on the active page (or pageIndex). Styles are applied first; explicit formatting overrides them.

alignment.description: Paragraph alignment (InDesign Justification; LEFT_JUSTIFIED = justified, last line left)

fontName.description: Font as "Family\tStyle" (e.g. "Arial\tRegular", InDesign's Font.name) or a family name (default: style/document default)

fontSize.description: Font size in points (default: style/document default)

pageIndex.description: Page index (0-based); defaults to the active page

textColor.description: Text color (default: style/document default): swatch name (e.g. "Black", "Paper") or "#RRGGBB"

x.description: X position in mm from the page left edge; omit position or size to have the frame placed automatically

y.description: Y position in mm from the page top edge

name: create_text_frame
title: Create Text Frame
